data.name: Luwaynah
data.gender_notes: Luwaynah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Arabic: لوينة (Lūyāna) derived from the Arabic word لوي (lūy) meaning 'light'. In Islamic context, it represents the light of God that guides and protects. The name Luwaynah carries the meaning “Light of God” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Luwaynah usually hope their child will grow to embody light of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Signifies the spiritual light that illuminates the heart and soul.
data.etymology: Luwaynah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Light of God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Luwaynah total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
